theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_puvd_plane_domain
theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (i : Fin q), Module.finrank ℝ (Ps i) = 2 → (∀ j, j ≠ i → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → ∃ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ IsConnected (V ∩ (Ps i : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ (Ps i : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0} ⊆ V ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → Disjoint V (Ps j : Set (Euclid P))
